rounds.text: Medico Remedies Ltd trades at an attractive discount relative to its intrinsic value, with a discounted cash flow model placing intrinsic value at Rs 64 per share against a market price of Rs 47.5, offering a margin of safety of 25.3% [E44, E45]. The business demonstrates robust capital efficiency, highlighted by a strong Return on Capital Employed of 20.98% that comfortably outpaces the sector benchmark of 6.47% [E10] and a solid ROE of 17.38% versus a negative sector benchmark [E9]. Growth metrics are equally compelling, propelled by a 37% compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months [E17] and a 38% compounded profit growth over five years [E19]. Furthermore, institutional money flow shows a positive reading [E43], and the stock price is currently trading above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E49], supported by a high rules-based screen score of 89 out of 100 [E64]. Conceded: promoter holdings have decreased by 11.96 percentage points since September 2023 [E40], and the company offers a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4].
